description: This file contains serialization and copying logic for array types and memory segments in the Orleans framework, including ArrayCodec, ArrayCopier, ReadOnlyMemoryCodec, ReadOnlyMemoryCopier, MemoryCodec, MemoryCopier, ArraySegmentCodec, and ArraySegmentCopier classes.

classes.name: ArrayCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for arrays of rank 1, handling serialization and deserialization of T[] arrays.

classes.name: ArrayCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for T[] arrays, enabling deep cloning of array elements.

classes.name: ReadOnlyMemoryCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for ReadOnlyMemory<T>, handling serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: ReadOnlyMemoryCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for ReadOnlyMemory<T>, enabling deep cloning of memory segments.

classes.name: MemoryCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for Memory<T>, handling serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: MemoryCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for Memory<T>, enabling deep cloning of memory segments.

classes.name: ArraySegmentCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for ArraySegment<T>, handling serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: ArraySegmentCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copier for ArraySegment<T>, enabling deep cloning of array segments.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes the array or memory segment into the writer stream.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes data from the reader stream into the array or memory segment.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the array or memory segment.
